info.title: Employee HRIS & Leave Management System REST API
info.description: Official enterprise REST API specification for the Employee HRIS & Leave Management System. Features role-based access control (strictly 'hr' and 'employee' roles), two-factor email OTP authentication, session cookie security with CSRF mitigation, workforce directory management, and full lifecycle leave request processing.

servers.description: Docker Nginx Reverse Proxy / Local Development Server

get.description: Returns the active session CSRF token for API clients, SPAs, and Swagger UI testing. Use this token in the 'X-CSRF-Token' header on all POST, PUT, DELETE, and PATCH operations.

post.description: Validates user email and password against secure password hashes. On success, generates a cryptographically secure 6-digit numeric OTP with a 5-minute expiry, sends it via email, and establishes a pending challenge session state. The user is NOT authenticated until Step 2 (/api/v1/auth/verify-otp) completes.

requestBody.description: Registered account email and password credentials

200.description: Primary credentials verified; Email OTP challenge dispatched

message.example: A 6-digit verification code has been dispatched to your registered email address.

400.description: Validation failure (missing required inputs or invalid email format)

message.example: Please provide both a valid email address and password.
Access is restricted to active HR and Employee accounts.

post.description: Validates the 6-digit numeric OTP challenge. On success, regenerates session ID, establishes authenticated user session cookie (PHPSESSID), and returns user profile data.

requestBody.description: 6-digit numeric OTP code received via email

400.description: Invalid OTP format or missing pending login session

message.example: Please enter a valid 6-digit numeric verification code.

401.description: Incorrect or expired OTP verification code

post.description: Issues a fresh 6-digit numeric OTP challenge for the current pending login session, subject to a 60-second rate-limiting cooldown window.

message.example: A fresh verification code has been dispatched to your email.
Please wait 45 seconds before requesting another verification code.

post.description: Destroys the current authenticated PHP session and clears session cookies.

get.description: Retrieves all departments along with associated job position counts and active employee headcounts. Accessible to authenticated users.

post.description: Creates a new department. Enforces unique department name validation. Restricted to HR accounts.

400.description: Validation failure (duplicate department name or missing required fields)

403.description: Forbidden: Restricted to HR role or CSRF token failure

get.description: Returns details of an organizational department including associated position and employee counts.

put.description: Updates department name and description. Enforces unique name validation excluding self. Restricted to HR accounts.

description.example: Brand management, events, and public relations

get.description: Retrieves the workforce directory. Allows filtering by search term (name, employee number, email), employment status, and department ID. Restricted to HR accounts.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Search term matching employee number, first name, last name, or email

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by employment status (Active, Inactive, Terminated)

post.description: Creates a new workforce record in the enterprise registry. Enforces unique employee numbers, valid registered emails, and foreign key alignment for department and position. Restricted to HR accounts.

400.description: Validation failure (duplicate employee number, email, or invalid dates)

403.description: Forbidden: Restricted to HR role or CSRF token failure

get.description: Returns comprehensive employee profile details, departmental alignment, and associated user account state. Restricted to HR accounts.

put.description: Updates an existing workforce profile. Enforces uniqueness excluding current record. Restricted to HR accounts.

post.description: Sets employee status to 'Inactive' and deactivates any associated login user account. Historical records and leave trails are strictly preserved. Restricted to HR accounts.

message.example: Employee has been placed on Inactive status.

get.description: Returns high-level system operational status and database connectivity check. Does not disclose sensitive environment configurations or internal database credentials.

get.summary: Detailed framework diagnostic endpoint (Existing landing health check)
get.description: Existing operational diagnostics endpoint providing latency and memory utilization telemetry.
Retrieves all currently active leave policy types (e.g. Vacation Leave, Sick Leave, Emergency Leave) along with default day allowances.

get.summary: List all leave categories with usage statistics
get.description: Retrieves all leave types (both Active and Inactive) including counts of associated leave requests and balance records. Restricted to HR accounts.

post.description: Configures a new leave type policy with default annual day quota. Restricted to HR accounts.

description.example: Leave allocated for death of immediate family members

400.description: Validation failure (duplicate name or invalid quota)

403.description: Forbidden: Restricted to HR role or CSRF token failure

get.summary: Retrieve personal leave quotas and balances
get.description: Returns the authenticated employee's allocated, used, and remaining leave quotas for the current or specified calendar year.

403.description: Forbidden: No employee record associated with account

get.description: Returns leave balances across all employees and departments for administrative oversight and reporting. Restricted to HR accounts.

post.description: Modifies an employee's allocated leave days for a specific leave category and year, automatically recalculating remaining days. Restricted to HR accounts.

403.description: Forbidden: Restricted to HR role or CSRF failure

get.description: Returns the authenticated employee's leave applications. Strictly enforces ownership boundaries; employees can never see other employees' applications.

403.description: Forbidden: No employee record associated with account

post.description: Files a new leave request. Automatically calculates eligible working days (Mon-Fri), verifies that dates do not overlap with existing pending/approved requests, and validates that sufficient leave quota remains.

400.description: Validation failure (overlapping request, insufficient balance, or zero working days)

403.description: Forbidden: No employee profile or CSRF validation failure

get.description: Returns details of a specific leave request. Strictly restricted to the employee who submitted it or HR personnel.

403.description: Forbidden: Not permitted to view another employee's request

post.description: Allows an employee to cancel their own pending leave application before it has been processed. Employees cannot cancel requests belonging to other employees or requests that are already Approved/Rejected.

400.description: Request cannot be cancelled (not in Pending status)

403.description: Forbidden: Not permitted to cancel another employee's request

get.description: Retrieves submitted leave requests across the workforce for review and adjudication. Allows filtering by status, employee, department, and date range. Restricted to HR accounts.

post.description: Executes atomic approval of a pending leave request, automatically deducting allocated quota from the employee's balance and re-verifying that no overlapping approval has occurred. Restricted to HR accounts.

400.description: Request cannot be approved (already processed or overlap detected)

403.description: Forbidden: Restricted to HR role or CSRF failure

post.description: Rejects a pending leave application and records the mandatory or optional administrative rejection rationale. Preserves employee leave balance quotas. Restricted to HR accounts.

rejection_reason.example: Operational staffing requirements during peak period

400.description: Request cannot be rejected (not in Pending status)

get.description: Retrieves all defined job classifications. Supports filtering by department ID.

post.description: Creates a new position classification aligned to an existing department. Enforces uniqueness within the department. Restricted to HR accounts.

400.description: Validation failure (duplicate position in department or invalid department ID)

403.description: Forbidden: Restricted to HR role or CSRF token failure

get.description: Returns position classification details, departmental alignment, and active headcount.

put.description: Updates position classification details and departmental assignment. Restricted to HR accounts.

description.example: Lead CI/CD pipeline automation and infrastructure

get.summary: Dynamic positions feed by department (Existing UI feed)
get.description: Existing operational background endpoint returning JSON positions belonging to a specified department ID for dynamic dropdown rendering.

cookieAuth.description: Native PHP Session Cookie. Established upon completing primary password login followed by email OTP verification.

csrfToken.description: Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF) validation token. Required on state-changing operations (POST, PUT, DELETE, PATCH). Obtainable via GET /api/v1/auth/csrf.
csrfToken.name: X-CSRF-Token
